verdict.rationale: Fellow's Developer API exposes paginated list endpoints (recordings, action items) and per-item write operations (append/prepend/find-replace agenda, mark action item complete, archive action item), so an AI-native user could script iteration over many items via the API, but there is no documented batch/bulk endpoint that acts on multiple items in a single call. missing for 10: explicit bulk/batch API operations (e.g., bulk-update many action items or notes in one request), evidence of bulk export or bulk delete beyond Super Admin's workspace-wide export/delete which is coarse-grained, not item-level bulk selection.
